Could you check whether agent jobs can start before `uv` provisioning is complete?

Script/service changes only, no change to the rest of the PR.

Pairs with sonic-net/sonic-linux-kernel#616, which adds the gpio-line-names this service looks up. Safe to merge in either order: on a kernel without the names, the service detects that and skips cleanly, preserving today's behavior.

Since the shim sbat level gets written to efi nvram, and is a one-way ratchet, shim 16.1 will require grub sbat version 5. Grub 2.12 is version 5, but grub 2.06 and older are at most version 4. This ratchet will always enforce grub sbat 5 forever if secure boot is enabled, so downgrade is impossible after this. We've run into this when attempting to test other releases on the same testbed, and other vendors/customers may run into issues like this as well.
